definitions.explanation: A structure made of posts and rails or boards used to enclose an area, prevent entry, or mark a boundary. Includes fences around gardens, barriers at construction sites, and railings along paths.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{柵|さく}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I built a fence around the garden.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{柵|さく}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えようとしている。
examples.english: A child is trying to climb over the fence.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}の{周|まわ}りに{安全|あんぜん}のための{柵|さく}が{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: Safety barriers have been installed around the construction site.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柵|さく}を{設|もう}ける: to set up a fence/barrier
- {柵|さく}を{越|こ}える: to go over a fence
- {鉄|てつ}{柵|さく}: iron fence/railing
- {防護|ぼうご}{柵|さく}: protective barrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
{塀|へい} refers to a solid wall (typically concrete or stone), while {柵|さく} refers to a fence or railing with gaps between the bars or boards.
